verdict.rationale: Numeral is a hosted sales-tax compliance SaaS, and self-hosting or on-prem deployment is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence describes only vendor-hosted services: API keys from the Numeral Dashboard, a hosted HTTPS MCP endpoint, and filing done by Numeral itself. Nothing documents a self-hostable or deployable version of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
